independentFindings.issue: The character document contains identity facts and unknown appearance notes, but no usable character-image prompt or required main figure, five full-body views, six head angles, clothing breakdown, material/color board and expression layout. Unknown appearance does not remove the required layout.

Material documents are story/environment descriptions, not complete image prompts. Scene documents omit the required dominant panorama plus matching detail insets on one canvas and n=1. The prop document describes plot use rather than an independent object-image prompt.
All four shot prompts omit the explicitly requested sections 【基础设定】, 【氛围与画质】, 动态流程 and 负面约束. Content also lacks the required detail density and per-cue performance/reaction specification.

Seven required literal lines are absent from the shot prompt. The phrase 其余核验对白按源文顺序继续 substitutes for complete text. Only five speech cues are present, so even one line printed in the prompt is missing from the typed speech plan.

The prompt assigns the complete customer-service exchange to seconds 8–30 (22 seconds), including lines it omits. The source's full exchange cannot be represented by claiming natural speech while compressing it into this interval; speech cue intervals also crowd the first lines.
All four scene prompts are summaries and do not include their ordered shot's complete prompt as explicitly required.

Customer-service dialogue and the recorded woman's speech are typed as narration/narration to satisfy validation. They are offscreen character speech in the source; speaker identity and visibility semantics have been conflated.
The shot shows the closed congee shop, but its bound scene document describes a generic city cycling route and omits the shop. Type-correct keys do not establish correct location coverage.
The speaking character has no defaultVoice relation, although a voice-shenmo object exists. Per-shot cues establish some relations but do not establish this default relation.
The opening states the old phone has already been put in the delivery box, then the 0–7 second action puts it in the box again. Initial state and action continuity conflict.

The source's state change from not actually collecting food to marked picked-up is omitted. Own working phone, bicycle and delivery box are used but have no corresponding material definitions; only the cracked old phone has a prop document.
